notes: The generator receives natural language and the shared room contract, never the reference annotation.
All experimental arms must reuse the same generated canonical scene for each case.
Easy cases use only binary relations; moderate cases include an explicit multi-object relation.
These cases calibrate P0b evidence and camera policies, not final leaderboard scores.

cases.instruction: Create a compact bedroom. Place a grey upholstered bed against the north wall. Put a dark brown wooden nightstand to the right of the bed and a mint green vintage alarm clock on the nightstand. Place a dark gray angular floor lamp to the left of the bed and a light gray pillow on the bed.

Create a small living room. Place a brown leather chesterfield sofa against the west wall. Put a dark wood coffee table in front of and parallel to the sofa, with a white ceramic vase on the table. Lay a deep red floral carpet on the floor in front of the sofa and place a dark gray angular floor lamp to the right of the sofa.

Create a study area. Place a dark angular wooden desk against the east wall and a brown leather office chair in front of it. Put a dark metallic monitor on the desk, with a teal blue paperback book to the left of the monitor and a vibrant green rosemary plant to its right.

Create a simple entryway. Place a concrete gray shoe cabinet against the south wall. Put a brown woven storage basket on the floor to the left of the cabinet, a concrete pebble fan palm on the floor to its right, and a white cylindrical floor lamp near the cabinet.

Create a cafe corner. Put a white marble coffee table near the center of the room. Place a gray metal bar stool to the left of the table and a light wood bar stool to its right. Set a dark gray ceramic mug and a white speckled ceramic bowl on the table, with the mug to the left of the bowl.

Create a dining room with a round wooden dining table at the center. Arrange four dark brown wooden chairs around the table, one on each side. Put a white ceramic vase on the table. Hang a sleek black pendant light from the ceiling directly above the table.

Create a shared office. Arrange three light wood school desks in one straight row from west to east. Put one brown leather office chair behind each desk. Place a dark metallic monitor on the middle desk and a concrete pebble fan palm to the right of the eastern desk.

Create a bedroom with a white upholstered bed against the north wall. Place one dark brown wooden nightstand on each side so that the bed is between them. Put a beige linen table lamp on each nightstand. Lay a beige geometric carpet on the floor in front of the bed, place a light gray pillow on the bed, and put a dark navy paperback book on the right nightstand.

Create a lounge with a round carved mahogany coffee table near the center. Arrange three black leather lounge chairs around the table. Place a dark gray fabric sofa behind and parallel to the table. Put a natural wooden bowl on the table, a dark gray angular floor lamp to the left of the sofa, and a burgundy geometric rug on the floor centered beneath the table.

Create a library study. Place a light wood shelving unit against the west wall. Arrange a teal blue paperback book, an aged parchment book, and a dark navy paperback book from left to right on its middle shelf. Put a dark brown wooden desk in front of the shelf with a brown leather office chair in front of the desk. Set a dark metallic monitor on the desk and place a brown woven storage basket to the right of the desk.
